payload.raw: S1 update via shelter desk: one still missing; low urgency, no immediate hazard reported.
Unverified post says smoke/fire by Oak Clinic. High urgency; no reliable head count.
At South Pump, water coming up FAST. One person here, this is critical. I'm looking at them.
Radio relay: family reports three people in S9. They need a welfare check, moderate priority.
I'm at Willow Park. One survivor on dry ground, moderate urgency, no hazards I can see.
...static... somebody over there by the thing, can't copy location... radio check?
S4, unconfirmed head count of two. Possible collapse risk. High priority, please verify.
Resident relays: water rising around Oak Clinic, two people stuck. Critical priority.
Possible person near Cedar Church, unconfirmed. Low urgency for now. Copy?
I see one sheltered under a damaged roof at Pine Station. Collapse risk, critical. Repeat critical.
txt from resident: neighbor says two stranded in S2. Haven't seen em myself, moderate urgency.
On scene at River Bridge, gas smell and one person waiting. High urgency. This is a firsthand report.
Correction command: retract the last report for River Bridge / S3. Bad location, cancel that report. Low urgency.
